definitions.explanation: A mathematical or general relationship where two quantities increase or decrease at the same rate. Also used in a broader sense for things that correlate with each other.
Short for proportional representation, an electoral system where seats are allocated in proportion to votes received.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}に{比例|ひれい}して{成果|せいか}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Results come in proportion to effort.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}の{増加|ぞうか}に{比例|ひれい}して{住宅|じゅうたく}{需要|じゅよう}も{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Housing demand is increasing in proportion to population growth.

examples.japanese: {収入|しゅうにゅう}と{幸福度|こうふくど}は{必|かなら}ずしも{比例|ひれい}しない。
examples.english: Income and happiness are not necessarily proportional.

examples.japanese: {比例|ひれい}{代表|だいひょう}{制|せい}では{小|しょう}さな{政党|せいとう}も{議席|ぎせき}を{得|え}やすい。
examples.english: Under the proportional representation system, even small parties can easily win seats.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}で{比例|ひれい}と{小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}の{両方|りょうほう}に{立候補|りっこうほ}できる。
examples.english: In the election, one can run as a candidate in both proportional representation and single-seat districts.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{選挙|せんきょ}では{比例|ひれい}で{三|さん}{議席|ぎせき}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: In this election, they won three seats through proportional representation.

notes:
USAGE:
In the general sense, commonly used with に{比例|ひれい}して (in proportion to). As a suru verb, it means "to be proportional." In the political sense, it is short for {比例|ひれい}{代表|だいひょう} (proportional representation) and is very common in election coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- Xに{比例|ひれい}して: in proportion to X
- {正|せい}{比例|ひれい}: direct proportion
- {反比例|はんぴれい}: inverse proportion
- {比例|ひれい}{代表|だいひょう}: proportional representation
- {比例|ひれい}{区|く}: proportional representation block
